properties.description: At every eligible pre/post observation, occupancy equals an independent depth-16 queue model. Acceptance uses expected pre-edge occupancy, blocking writes at full and reads at empty even for simultaneous requests.
Full is known and asserted exactly when the independent expected queue contains 16 words.
Empty is known and asserted exactly when the independent expected queue contains zero words.

Whenever the expected queue is nonempty, asynchronous front data equals its oldest accepted word, checking ordering and preservation across stalls, simultaneous transfers, wraparound, and reset. Empty data is unconstrained.
Public occupancy is known and within zero through 16, and public full and empty flags are known and consistent with that occupancy.
After every synchronous reset edge, through the next pre-edge observation, occupancy is zero, full is clear, and empty is asserted, including resets during operation.
